founder.name: Rufus Pennick
founder.headline: Story first: your next customers already read LinkedIn. Reach them with stories they recognise.

content.found: Rufus publishes long narrative posts on LinkedIn with invented characters to show how a reader who was not shopping can stop for a story that fits their situation.
content.projected: Each week, story posts drafted under his name sit ready for his review before they go out.

inbound.found: His website offers a small paid pilot that delivers a file of customer stories, and readers who engage with posts are pointed to the comments or a DM.
inbound.projected: A lead magnet under his name turns post readers into named leads by giving them one concrete part of his method to take away.

outbound.found: The corpus shows no record of follow-up to the people who reacted to or commented on his posts.
outbound.projected: A short personal note to every warm engager gets drafted for his review before it sends.

posts.source_quote: We ask them one question. What were you feeling when the moment happened?

posts.hook: She called me on a Thursday, about an hour after I sent the file.
posts.source_quote: Our deliverable is the results file. The customer's own words, kept as they said them.

posts.hook: After a few stories run, I ask the client to look at who came back.
posts.source_quote: Every story you share leaves the readers thinking a little differently than they did before.

posts.hook: Most campaigns we audit never measured what the story changed.
posts.source_quote: Most campaigns we audit never measured what the story changed. None of them.

content.found: Odile publishes first-person LinkedIn posts under her own name about talent representation, production economics and her path from brand and agency roles into founding brack.
content.projected: A week of posts goes out under her name, waiting for her approval.

inbound.found: Readers respond to her posts only through likes, comments and DMs she invites case by case, such as "DM if that's you" on a launch post.
inbound.projected: A lead magnet under her name turns readers into named leads.

outbound.found: Engagement on her posts sits in LinkedIn's native reactions and comments with no described follow-up process to the people who engage.
outbound.projected: A short personal note goes out to every warm engager, drafted for her approval.

posts.hook: A client walked away from a project because we kept our first internal review internal.
posts.source_quote: We offered every option, a call an hour after our meeting, tomorrow, the day after, anything except the very first internal review.

posts.hook: A client went quiet once because our team kept our first review to ourselves.
posts.source_quote: we kept her in the loop: here is the plan, here is the progress, today we review internally

posts.hook: A creative team I know once spent months trying to get onto a brand everyone wants to work with.
posts.source_quote: My credibility carries them. It covers the clumsy moments while they find their feet.

posts.hook: A production house once sent me a cost breakdown for an ad that was never made.
posts.source_quote: Creative development was a small slice of their budget, while the mark up around it was fine

founder.name: Jarle Vindholm
founder.headline: Branding, design and Webflow | Partner & Creative Director @ Glødhus

audience.buyer_definition: a founder or marketing lead at a growing company who needs a brand refresh or new website

content.found: His own feed already carries first-person case-study posts about client projects like Bjørkly and Tindestua, published directly under his name.
content.projected: Once the system runs, a full week of posts sits ready under his name, waiting for his approval.

inbound.found: By his own description, incoming requests already fill his week, leaving him little time to look for new clients.
inbound.projected: A lead magnet carrying his name would turn those same readers into named leads.

outbound.found: He thanks clients and collaborators by name inside his posts, engaging with the people who worked with him rather than through any separate outreach step.
outbound.projected: A short personal note goes out to every warm engager, drafted for his approval before it sends.

posts.hook: Skriften på Bjørkly sin nye nettside er valgt for å matche håndverket i møblene de lager.
posts.source_quote: Fonten vi valgte heter Kvern, fra et lite skriftstudio. Inspirert av gamle trykkerier.

posts.hook: Bjørkly sin nye side og logo har vært live en stund nå, og vi justerer den fortsatt.
posts.source_quote: Nå gjelder det å optimalisere videre, like viktig for små og store nettsider.

posts.hook: Når vi leverer en side i Webflow, får kunden full kontroll over den med en gang.
posts.source_quote: Med Webflow har kundene kontroll. De oppdaterer selv, endrer innhold og legger til sider uten venting.

posts.hook: Vi leverte Tindestua sin nye nettside en tirsdag, og torsdag var trafikken like lav som uken før.
posts.source_quote: Vente på at Google og kundene oppdager den nye siden, og følge med på resultatene.
